notes.title: Patch 1.002 Notes
notes.content:
Fixes and Improvements:

- Pause Functionality


Game will now automatically pause whenever player opens the Settings menu during a match against CPU


- Ball Visual Effect Enhancement


 Increased rotational dynamics of the ball

notes.title: Patch 1.001 Notes
notes.content:
Features:

- New Ball-Focused Camera: A new camera option has been added that centers on the ball during gameplay.


Players can now toggle between the character and ball-focused cameras.

The default key to switch to the ball-focused camera is "B" and this keybinding can be customized in the key configuration menu.
